caption: 3 qubits: 2x2x2=8 basis states. Each added qubit multiplies the dimension by 2, it doesn't add 2.

steps.label: Direct sum (A (+) B): stacks spaces, adds dimensions
steps.sub: Used for 'either system A or B is active' — no correlation possible

steps.label: Tensor product (A (x) B): both systems exist at once
steps.sub: Tracks every possible correlation — this is what qubits need
